fact: The Electoral Commission of Namibia's chief electoral officer said registration data would be uploaded to the central server, followed by the Automatic Fingerprint Identification System (AFIS) process and production of the Provisional Voters' Register, after 1,467,604 voters registered by 1 August 2024.

The Electoral Commission of Namibia says voter data captured with biometric Voter Registration Kits is uploaded to a central server, checked for duplicate fingerprints and ID numbers, and stored on a voters roll.
system: Voter Registration Kit biometric voters roll
